why: spins ONE node's callbacks on a temporary executor. RFC-0002 puts one executor per RTOS task, SHARED by every node in that tier, and the arena is indexed by `HandleId`, not by node -- a node is not a unit of dispatch here. What a user loses: draining one node's queue while another node's callbacks stay pending. Also needs a throwaway executor per call, which no allocator -- one global `nros_platform_alloc` and inline caller-owned storage. See `cpp:Node::make_shared` and the `no-shared-ptr` rule in signature_rules.py.
